title: Forming his own band with older musicians
summary: He formed a band of his own with older men like Picou, Toca, Dominguez, Ike Roberson, and Boyd.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Did you practice by yourself a while or when did you join, when did you join the band?
I made a band out of my own. I made a band out of my own.
Soon after you started? That's right. Who else was in there in a band?

I had the old musicians with me. Really? That's right, I had old man granny, Alphonse Pico, Johnny Dave, Lil' Orange Toker, Gassoun, you remember Gassoun, you got to. I had all old musicians. Lil' Orange Toker and me was the two youngest fellas. I mostly worked with old fellas, I mean when I started, I mean, most old fellas.
And Toker was the carnet player?
The carnet player, he was younger than anybody in the band. He was pretty young.
What band you had, Arnest, when a violin player, what's his name? Oh, Pete, not Pete, uh, Pete. I was playing with you, Tapper's friend. Oh, uh, uh, Dominguez.
Dominguez. Yeah, Paul Dominguez. Paul Dominguez, he worked with me too. What you had in the band with you then, him and whoever? Them Tatt. Tatt, old man granny, Billy, the piano player, Lil' Orange.
Big Ike, Big Ike Roberson, he was playing with me. Dede, Dede, his wife.
Oh, Billy. Yeah, she played piano with me.
He played. And we had a band together, me and Willie Darren Boyd. We worked at Millen Boyd together.

Lil' Deden Boyd's a violin player, he lived in Batten World. Oh, the Davenport? Darren's Boyd. Darren's Boyd. Oh, Darren's Boyd. That's Caffrey's cousin. Oh, sure, sure. The great band, I'll play Caffrey's cousin. Sure.
Um, did you have a name on that first band? Any just your band? Or did you have any...
Oh, he's in his jazz band.
